stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个来自西方的男人。
他的爱好是学习汉语。
昨天，他来到了北京。
他住的地方很漂亮。
房间的东边有一个大窗户。
窗户的外边可以看到很多绿色的树。
房间的西边是一张床。
床的上边有一个小灯。
大卫想记下这里的所有事情。
他拿出一本笔记本，写道：“北京很大。”
今天早上，他在门口看到了一个老先生。
老先生穿着一件红色的衣服。
大卫走上前边，礼貌地问路。
老先生说：“你想去哪里？”
大卫说：“我想去北边的公园。”
老先生笑着说：“那个地方在北面，但现在你得往南边走。”
大卫有点糊涂，因为他分不清东西方向。
老先生指着右边说：“你先往右走。”
然后他又指着左边说：“到了路口，再往左边转。”
大卫问：“我还是走不到那里吗？”
老先生说：“马上就能到了，就在那个建筑的后边。”
大卫走到了公园门口，看到一个漂亮的亭子。
亭子的旁边有一个小商店。
商店里卖很多好吃的面包。
大卫买了一些面包给老先生。
他邀请老先生进去坐坐。
老先生走进亭子，大卫说：“请坐。”
老先生说：“谢谢你，好孩子。”
他们坐在那里聊天。
老先生教大卫下棋，大卫走了一着棋。
老先生说：“这步棋走得不错！”
大卫很高兴，他觉得学习汉语很有意思。
明天，他打算去看看故宫。
他希望明天也是一个好天气。
stories.story_pinyin:
Dà wèi shì yī gè lái zì xī fāng de nán rén.
Tā de ài hào shì xué xí Hàn yǔ.
Zuó tiān, tā lái dào le Běi jīng.
Tā zhù de dì fāng hěn piào liang.
Fáng jiān de dōng bian yǒu yī gè dà chuāng hu.
Chuāng hu de wài bian kě yǐ kàn dào hěn duō lǜ sè de shù.
Fáng jiān de xī bian shì yī zhāng chuáng.
Chuáng de shàng bian yǒu yī gè xiǎo dēng.
Dà wèi xiǎng jì xià zhè lǐ de suǒ yǒu shì qing.
Tā ná chū yī běn bǐ jì běn, xiě dào: “Běi jīng hěn dà.”
Jīn tiān zǎo shang, tā zài mén kǒu kàn dào le yī gè lǎo xiān sheng.
Lǎo xiān sheng chuān zhe yī jiàn hóng sè de yī fu.
Dà wèi zǒu zài qián bian, lǐ mào de wèn lù.
Lǎo xiān sheng shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng qù nà li?”
Dà wèi shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù běi bian de gōng yuán.”
Lǎo xiān sheng xiào zhe shuō: “Nà gè dì fāng zài běi miàn, dàn xiàn zài nǐ děi wǎng nán bian zǒu.”
Dà wèi yǒu diǎn hú tu, yīn wèi tā fēn bù qīng dōng xī fāng xiàng.
Lǎo xiān sheng zhǐ zhe yòu bian shuō: “Nǐ xiān wǎng yòu zǒu.”
 rán hòu tā yòu zhǐ zhe zuǒ bian shuō: “Dào le lù kǒu, zài wǎng zuǒ bian zhuǎn.”
Dà wèi wèn: “Wǒ hái shi zǒu bù dào nà li ma?”
Lǎo xiān sheng shuō: “Mǎ shàng jiù néng dào le, jiù zài nà gè jiàn zhù de hòu bian.”
Dà wèi zǒu dào le gōng yuán mén kǒu, kàn dào yī gè piào liang de tíng zi.
Tíng zi de páng biān yǒu yī gè xiǎo shāng diàn.
Shāng diàn lǐ mài hěn duō hǎo chī de miàn bāo.
Dà wèi mǎi le yī xiē miàn bāo gěi lǎo xiān sheng.
Tā yāo qǐng lǎo xiān sheng jìn qù zuò zuò.
Lǎo xiān sheng zǒu jìn tíng zi, Dà wèi shuō: “Qǐng zuò.”
Lǎo xiān sheng shuō: “Xiè xie nǐ, hǎo hái zi.”
Tā men zuò zài nà li liáo tiān.
Lǎo xiān sheng jiāo Dà wèi xià qí, Dà wèi zǒu le yī zhāo qí.
Lǎo xiān sheng shuō: “Zhè bù qí zǒu de bù cuò!”
Dà wèi hěn gāo xìng, tā jué de xué xí Hàn yǔ hěn yǒu yì si.
Míng tiān, tā dǎ suàn qù kàn kàn Gù gōng.
Tā xī wàng míng tiān yě shì yī gè hǎo tiān qì.
stories.story_english:
David is a man from the West.
His hobby is learning Chinese.
Yesterday, he arrived in Beijing.
The place where he lives is very beautiful.
On the east side of the room, there is a large window.
Outside the window, one can see many green trees.
On the west side of the room is a bed.
Above the bed, there is a small lamp.
David wanted to record everything here.
He took out a notebook and wrote, "Beijing is very big."
This morning, he saw an old gentleman at the doorway.
The old gentleman was wearing a piece of red clothing.
David walked to the front and politely asked for directions.
The old gentleman asked, "Where do you want to go?"
David said, "I want to go to the park in the north side."
The old gentleman smiled and said, "That place is to the north, but right now you must walk toward the south side."
David was a bit confused because he couldn't tell east and west directions.
The old gentleman pointed to the right side and said, "First, walk to the right."
Then he pointed to the left side and said, "When you reach the intersection, turn to the left side."
David asked, "Am I still unable to reach there?"
The old gentleman said, "You will arrive immediately; it is just behind that building."
David walked to the park entrance and saw a beautiful pavilion.
Beside the pavilion, there was a small shop.
The shop sold a lot of delicious bread.
David bought some bread for the old gentleman.
He invited the old gentleman to go in and sit for a while.
The old gentleman entered the pavilion, and David said, "Please have a seat."
The old gentleman said, "Thank you, good boy."
They sat there chatting.
The old gentleman taught David how to play chess, and David made a move.
The old gentleman said, "This move was not bad!"
David was very happy; he felt that learning Chinese was very interesting.
Tomorrow, he plans to go visit the Forbidden City.
He hopes tomorrow will also be a day of good weather.

stories.story_chinese:
大卫是一个很喜欢看书的人。
他住在北京，这里有很多有名的书店。
今天是一个星期三。
白天，大卫在公司工作，他常常觉得时间不够用。
中午的时候，他习惯先吃一点东西，然后再休息一会儿。
他觉得生活太快了，快得让他有些累。
有一天下午，大卫决定去逛逛书店。
他走进一家不大但很温馨的小店。
店里有一些旧书，有的书很厚，有的书很薄。
他在这里看了半天，寻找一本关于时间的书。
他问店员：“请问，这本书多少钱？”
店员告诉他，这本书很便宜，只要十块钱。
大卫想，虽然他已经买了很多书，但这本书很特别。
他有时候会想，如果能让时间慢下来就好了。
他在书店里待了半个小时，感觉心很安静。
他看到别人在快步走，而他想慢慢地看书。
他想，除了看书，没有别的更好的休息方式了。
这时候，他想起了一个老朋友，叫王先生。
王先生有时会来这家书店，他是一个很有趣的人。
大卫想，我现在是不是应该给王先生打个电话？
他拿出手机，但发现手机没电了。
他心想，没关系，我可以等一会儿再打。
他坐在窗边，看着窗外的阳光，觉得真舒服。
他发现，生活中有一些简单的时刻是最美好的。
有些时候，我们不需要跑得那么快。
他决定在最后离开之前，再买一本笔记本。
这是他这个星期第二次来这家店。
他对店员说：“谢谢，再见！”
走出书店，大卫觉得心情很愉快。
他不再觉得时间太少，而是觉得每一秒都很珍贵。
他走在路上，看着天空，思考着生活。
他知道，只要心慢下来，时间就变得很多。
他决定每天给自己留一点时间，安静地思考。
这就是大卫今天发现的小秘密。
stories.story_pinyin:
Dà wèi shì yī gè hěn xǐ huān kàn shū de rén.
Tā zhù zài Běi jīng, zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō yǒu míng de shū diàn.
Jīn tiān shì yī gè xīng qī sān.
Bái tiān, Dà wèi zài gōng sī gōng zuò, tā cháng cháng jué de shí jiān bù gòu yòng.
Zhōng wǔ de shí hou, tā xí guàn xiān chī yī diǎn dōng xi, rán hòu zài xiū xi yī huì r.
Tā jué de shēng huó tài kuài le, kuài de ràng tā yǒu xiē lèi.
Yǒu yī tiān xià wǔ, Dà wèi jué dìng qù guàng guàng shū diàn.
Tā zǒu jìn yī jiā bù dà dàn hěn wēn xīn de xiǎo diàn.
Diàn lǐ yǒu yī xiē jiù shū, yǒu de shū hěn hòu, yǒu de shū hěn báo.
Tā zài zhè lǐ kàn le bàn tiān, xún zhǎo yī běn guān yú shí jiān de shū.
Tā wèn diàn yuán: “Qǐng wèn, zhè běn shū duō shǎo qián?”
Diàn yuán gào su tā, zhè běn shū hěn pián yi, zhǐ yào shí kuài qián.
Dà wèi xiǎng, suī rán tā yǐ jīng mǎi le hěn duō shū, dàn zhè běn shū hěn tè bié.
Tā yǒu shí hou huì xiǎng, rú guǒ néng ràng shí jiān màn xià lái jiù hǎo le.
Tā zài shū diàn lǐ dāi le bàn gè xiǎo shí, gǎn jué xīn hěn ān jìng.
Tā kàn dào bié ren zài kuài bù zǒu, ér tā xiǎng màn màn de kàn shū.
Tā xiǎng, chú le kàn shū, méi yǒu bié de gèng hǎo de xiū xi fāng shì le.
Zhè shí hou, tā xiǎng qǐ le yī gè lǎo péng you, jiào Wáng xiān sheng.
Wáng xiān sheng yǒu shí huì lái zhè jiā shū diàn, tā shì yī gè hěn yǒu qù de rén.
Dà wèi xiǎng, wǒ xiàn zài shì bù shì yīng gāi gěi Wáng xiān sheng dǎ gè diàn huà?
Tā ná chū shǒu jī, dàn fā xiàn shǒu jī méi diàn le.
Tā xīn xiǎng, méi guān xi, wǒ kě yǐ děng yī huì r zài dǎ.
Tā zuò zài chuāng biān, kàn zhe chuāng wài de yáng guāng, jué de zhēn shū fu.
Tā fā xiàn, shēng huó zhōng yǒu yī xiē jiǎn dān de shí kè shì zuì měi hǎo de.
Yǒu xiē shí hou, wǒ men bù xū yào pǎo de nà me kuài.
Tā jué dìng zài zuì hòu lí kāi zhī qián, zài mǎi yī běn bǐ jì běn.
Zhè shì tā zhè gè xīng qī dì èr cì lái zhè jiā diàn.
Tā duì diàn yuán shuō: “Xiè xie, zài jiàn!”
Zǒu chū shū diàn, Dà wèi jué de xīn qíng hěn yú kuài.
Tā bù zài jué de shí jiān tài shǎo, ér shì jué de měi yī miǎo dōu hěn zhēn guì.
Tā zǒu zài lù shàng, kàn zhe tiān kōng, sī kǎo zhe shēng huó.
Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào xīn màn xià lái, shí jiān jiù biàn de hěn duō.
Tā jué dìng měi tiān gěi zì jǐ liú yī diǎn shí jiān, ān jìng de sī kǎo.
Zhè jiù shì Dà wèi jīn tiān fā xiàn de xiǎo mì mì.
stories.story_english:
David is a person who likes reading books very much.
He lives in Beijing, where there are many famous bookstores.
Today is Wednesday.
During the day, David works at a company, and he often feels that time is not enough.
At noon, he is used to eating a little something first, and then resting for a while.
He feels that life is too fast, so fast that it makes him somewhat tired.
One afternoon, David decided to visit a bookstore.
He walked into a small shop that was not very big but very cozy.
There were some old books in the shop; some were thick, and some were thin.
He looked around here for a long time, searching for a book about time.
He asked the clerk, "Excuse me, how much is this book?"
The clerk told him that this book is very cheap, only ten yuan.
David thought that although he had already bought many books, this book was very special.
Sometimes he would think that it would be great if time could slow down.
He stayed in the bookstore for half an hour and felt his heart was very quiet.
He saw other people walking quickly, while he wanted to read slowly.
He thought that apart from reading, there was no other better way to relax.
At this moment, he remembered an old friend named Mr. Wang.
Mr. Wang sometimes comes to this bookstore; he is a very interesting person.
David thought, should I call Mr. Wang now?
He took out his phone but found that the phone had no battery.
He thought to himself, it's okay, I can wait a moment and then call.
He sat by the window, looking at the sunlight outside, and felt truly comfortable.
He discovered that some simple moments in life are the most beautiful.
Some times, we don't need to run so fast.
He decided to buy one more notebook before finally leaving.
This was the second time he had come to this shop this week.
He said to the clerk, "Thank you, goodbye!"
Walking out of the bookstore, David felt very happy.
He no longer felt that time was too little, but felt that every second was precious.
He walked on the road, looking at the sky and thinking about life.
He knew that as long as the heart slows down, time becomes plenty.
He decided to leave a little time for himself every day to think quietly.
This is the little secret David discovered today.

stories.title_english: A Warm Morning at the Gao Family's
stories.story_chinese:
高先生有一个温暖的家。
他有一个儿子和一个女儿。
他的儿子叫大卫，是一个好哥哥。
他的女儿叫小美，是一个可爱的妹妹。
大卫和妹妹在这个家里一起长大。
大卫是家里的长子，他很照顾弟弟妹妹。
虽然他没有亲弟弟，但他把邻居的小男孩当成弟弟一样对待。
今天早晨，高先生在厨房准备早餐。
桌子上有很多好吃的：有热腾腾的包子，有白色的米饭，还有鸡蛋。
小美走进来，问爸爸：“我能喝牛奶吗？”
高先生笑着说：“当然可以，快来吃早餐。”
这时，大卫的姐姐也回来了。
姐姐在大学学习，她有很多知识。
她经常在网上看书，学习新东西。
姐姐告诉大卫：“你要记住，学习很重要。”
大卫点头说：“我知道，姐。”
姐姐说：“哥，你也要帮妹妹洗手。”
大卫牵着妹妹的手走向洗手间。
洗完手后，两个孩子在院子里的树下玩儿。
这时，门外响起了敲门声。
那是姐姐的男朋友，他给孩子们带来了礼物。
姐姐在门边说：“请进！”
男朋友笑着走进屋子，来到里边。
他问：“孩子们，你们喜欢这个礼物吗？”
小朋友们高兴地跳了起来。
礼物是一个很贵的精美笔记本。
大卫翻开笔记本，发现每一页都很干净。
高先生看着自己的儿子和女儿，感到很幸福。
在这个家里，女孩子和男孩子都得到了爱。
每个孩子都像小种子一样在爱中成长。
大卫问姐姐：“我们可以一起看书吗？”
姐姐说：“好，我们一起学习。”
阳光洒在院子里，树叶在风中摇曳。
这个早晨充满了欢笑和温暖。
高家的人们永远相爱。
stories.story_pinyin:
Gāo xiān sheng yǒu yí ge wēn nuǎn de jiā.
Tā yǒu yí ge ér zi hé yí ge nǚ ér.
Tā de ér zi jiào Dà wèi, shì yí ge hǎo gē ge.
Tā de nǚ ér jiào Xiǎo měi, shì yí ge kě ài de mèi mei.
Dà wèi hé mèi mei zài zhè ge jiā lǐ yì qǐ zhǎng dà.
Dà wèi shì jiā lǐ de zhǎng zǐ, tā hěn zhào gù dì di mèi mei.
Suī rán tā méi yǒu qīn dì di, dàn tā bǎ lín jū de xiǎo nán hái dàng chéng dì di yí yàng duì dài.
Jīn tiān zǎo chen, Gāo xiān sheng zài chú fáng zhǔn bèi zǎo cān.
Zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō hǎo chī de: yǒu rè téng téng de bāo zi, yǒu bái sè de mǐ fàn, hái yǒu jī dàn.
Xiǎo měi zǒu jìn lái, wèn bà ba: "Wǒ néng hē niú nǎi ma?"
Gāo xiān sheng xiào zhe shuō: "Dāng rán kě yǐ, kuài lái chī zǎo cān."
Zhè shí, Dà wèi de jiě jie yě huí lái le.
Jiě jie zài dà xué xué xí, tā yǒu hěn duō zhī shi.
Tā jīng cháng zài wǎng shàng kàn shū, xué xí xīn dōng xi.
Jiě jie gào su Dà wèi: "Nǐ yào jì zhu, xué xí hěn zhòng yào."
Dà wèi diǎn tóu shuō: "Wǒ zhī dào, jiě."
Jiě jie shuō: "Gē, nǐ yě yào bāng mèi mei xǐ shǒu."
Dà wèi qiān zhe mèi mei de shǒu zǒu xiàng xǐ shǒu jiān.
Xǐ wán shǒu hòu, liǎng ge hái zi zài yuàn zi lǐ de shù xià wán r.
Zhè shí, mén wài xiǎng qǐ le qiāo mén shēng.
Nà shì jiě jie de nán péng you, tā gěi hái zi men dài lái le lǐ wù.
Jiě jie zài mén biān shuō: "Qǐng jìn!"
Nán péng you xiào zhe zǒu jìn wū zi, lái dào lǐ bian.
Tā wèn: "Hái zi men, nǐ men xǐ huan zhè ge lǐ wù ma?"
Xiǎo péng yǒu men gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái.
Lǐ wù shì yí ge hěn guì de jīng měi bǐ jì běn.
Dà wèi fān kāi bǐ jì běn, fā xiàn měi yí yè dōu hěn gān jìng.
Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe zì jǐ de ér zi hé nǚ ér, gǎn dào hěn xìng fú.
Zài zhè ge jiā lǐ, nǚ hái zi hé nán hái zi dōu dé dào le ài.
Měi ge hái zi dōu xiàng xiǎo zǐ zi yí yàng zài ài zhōng chéng zhǎng.
Dà wèi wèn jiě jie: "Wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ kàn shū ma?"
Jiě jie shuō: "Hǎo, wǒ men yì qǐ xué xí."
Yáng guāng sǎ zài yuàn zi lǐ, shù yè zài fēng zhōng yáo yè.
Zhè ge zǎo chen chōng mǎn le huān xiào hé wēn nuǎn.
Gāo jiā de rén men yǒng yuǎn xiāng ài.
stories.story_english:
Mr. Gao has a warm home.
He has a son and a daughter.
His son is called David, and he is a good older brother.
His daughter is called Xiaomei, and she is a lovely younger sister.
David and his younger sister grew up together in this home.
David is the eldest son of the family, and he takes great care of his younger siblings.
Although he has no biological younger brother, he treats the neighbor's little boy like a younger brother.
This morning, Mr. Gao was preparing breakfast in the kitchen.
There were many delicious things on the table: steaming bao buns, white rice, and eggs.
Xiaomei walked in and asked her father, "Can I drink some milk?"
Mr. Gao said with a smile, "Of course, come and eat breakfast."
At this time, David's older sister also returned.
The older sister studies at university, and she has a lot of knowledge.
She often reads books online to learn new things.
Older sister told David, "You must remember that studying is very important."
David nodded and said, "I know, sister."
Older sister said, "Brother, you also need to help younger sister wash her hands."
David held his younger sister's hand and walked toward the bathroom.
After washing their hands, the two children played under the tree in the yard.
Just then, there was a knock at the door.
It was the older sister's boyfriend; he brought gifts for the children.
Older sister said by the door, "Please come in!"
The boyfriend smiled and walked into the house, going inside.
He asked, "Children, do you like this gift?"
The little children jumped up happily.
The gift was a very expensive and exquisite notebook.
